description.zh:
设置访问的模块，取值：

- `Registry`：访问镜像仓库

- `Chart`：访问Helm Chart
description.en:
The name of the module that you want to access. Valid values:

*   `Registry`: the image repository.
*   `Chart`: a Helm chart.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cr get-instance-vpc-endpoint --instance-id cri-kmsiwlxxdcva0000 --module-name Chart --region cn-hangzhou
